text_ar_search:
وعن عائشة قالت: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: 
"الرحم معلقة بالعرش تقول: من وصلني، وصله الله، ومن قطعني، قطعه الله" ((متفق عليه)).
text_en: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The bond of relationship is suspending from the Throne, and says: 'He who keeps good relations with me, Allah will keep connection with him, but whosoever severs relations with me, Allah will sever connection with him"..
